title: Unsun Karuta
mustFollow: Declared - follow the led suit (anything goes if you are void).
canDeclare: You lead. "Play and declare" makes this trick must-follow for everyone.

hint.lead_strong: lead something strong and keep the initiative
hint.follow_play: take it if you can; drop cheaply when your side already leads
hint.next_trick: move on to the next trick
hint.next_round: move on to the next deal

tutorial.trickDisplay: All eight seats play one card. The highest trump, or the highest card of the led suit if no trump was played, takes one "ko" for that team.
tutorial.info: Unsun Karuta is the oldest surviving Japanese trick-taking game: 75 cards in five suits of fifteen, eight players in two teams of four seated alternately - your neighbours are always opponents.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. **The pip order flips with the suit**: nine is highest in the long suits (Pao, Isu), one is highest in the round suits (Kotsu, Oru, Kuru). The court cards run Un > Sun > Sota > Robai > Kiri > Uma and all beat every pip.
tutorial.playButton: Select a card and press Play. When you lead you may also "Play and declare" (meri/monchi), which makes the trick must-follow for everyone.
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
